title: BioVAT ingest_bam_or_cram pipeline parameters
description: Validate, sort and index user-provided BAM/CRAM files, with optional alignment QC

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data.

samplesheet.description: BioVAT samplesheet (CSV) with the columns sample, library_id, flowcell_id, lane, platform, fastq_1, fastq_2, bam and single_end. Rows with a bam are used and rows with fastq files are skipped. Read group information is built from the columns.

bam_cram.description: Alternative to --samplesheet: a YAML or JSON file with one entry per BAM/CRAM file. Fields: meta (a map with id, library, pl, platform_unit and read_group) and bam_cram (the file). Use either --samplesheet or --bam_cram.

fasta.description: Reference fasta file. Needed to decode CRAM files.

fai.description: Fai index of the reference fasta. Used by Riker. Created from --fasta when it is needed and not given.

align_qc.description: Run quality checks on the alignments (BAM/CRAM).

riker.description: Run Riker during the alignment QC. Needs --fasta, and its fai index, which is created when not given.

qualimap.description: Run Qualimap during the alignment QC. Not compatible with cram_format.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
